name: smart-compact
description: Asks Haiku after each turn whether the work just reached a clean break, such as a commit, PR or approved plan, and compacts there with a summary shaped for it. Asks again only once the context has grown 20 points since the last compaction; leaves full-context and idle compaction to Claude Code.

decider.title: Decider
decider.description: The model that judges whether the work reached a clean break. Each judgement is one short call that counts toward your usage.

floor.title: Compact from
floor.description: Context fill under which the decider is not asked.

continue.title: Continue after
continue.description: Send a prompt to carry on after compacting while todos or tasks are still open, unless the turn was interrupted or ended on a question.
